title: Beelzebul Multi-Layer Repository Guard
purpose: Read-only, deterministic repository security audit. The quantum layer is cross-file correlation analysis, not a claim of quantum computation.

rules.title: Credential assignment
rules.description: Detects likely API keys, access tokens, passwords and client secrets in literals.

rules.title: Cloud access identifier
rules.description: Detects AWS-style access-key identifiers in tracked text.

rules.title: Private-key material
rules.description: Detects private-key PEM headers in tracked text.

rules.title: High-entropy secret literal
rules.description: Flags long, high-entropy strings assigned to secret-like names.

rules.title: Bidirectional control
rules.description: Detects Unicode bidirectional controls that can disguise source order.

rules.title: Zero-width character
rules.description: Detects zero-width and byte-order characters in source/configuration.

rules.title: NUL or unexpected control byte
rules.description: Detects NUL and non-whitespace control bytes in text/source files.

rules.title: Unresolved merge marker
rules.description: Detects unresolved Git conflict markers in tracked text.

rules.title: Mixed line endings
rules.description: Detects CRLF/LF mixtures inside one file.

rules.title: Oversized text artifact
rules.description: Flags text files above the configured size bound.

rules.title: Invalid UTF-8 text
rules.description: Detects invalid UTF-8 in files expected to be text.

rules.title: Ambiguous Unicode space
rules.description: Detects non-breaking and unusual Unicode spaces in code/configuration.

rules.title: Plaintext HTTP endpoint
rules.description: Detects non-local HTTP endpoints in executable/configuration files.

rules.title: Credential disclosure path
rules.description: Detects credential-like values passed to print/logging calls.

rules.title: Sensitive credential filename
rules.description: Detects private environment files, key stores and private-key filenames.

rules.title: Dynamic expression execution
rules.description: Detects eval/exec-style execution sinks in production source.

rules.title: Shell-enabled process execution
rules.description: Detects subprocess calls configured with shell execution.

rules.title: OS command execution
rules.description: Detects direct operating-system shell helpers.

rules.title: Unsafe object deserialization
rules.description: Detects pickle load operations on untrusted object streams.

rules.title: Unsafe YAML loading
rules.description: Detects YAML load calls without an explicit safe loader.

rules.title: Weak digest primitive
rules.description: Detects MD5/SHA-1 use outside clearly named compatibility code.

rules.title: TLS verification disabled
rules.description: Detects requests made with certificate verification disabled.

rules.title: Interpolated SQL execution
rules.description: Detects common string interpolation immediately at SQL execute calls.

rules.title: Unsafe temporary filename
rules.description: Detects race-prone temporary-name generation.

rules.title: Legacy XML parser
rules.description: Detects XML parsing entry points requiring explicit entity/DTD hardening.

rules.title: Input-to-process correlation
rules.description: Detects external input flowing into process invocation on the same source line.

rules.title: Dynamic module loading
rules.description: Detects variable-driven imports requiring a trust-boundary review.

rules.title: Input-derived filesystem path
rules.description: Detects request/argument-derived paths passed to file opening calls.

rules.title: Nested-repeat regular expression
rules.description: Detects likely catastrophic-backtracking regex structures.

rules.title: Swallowed exception
rules.description: Detects broad exception handlers that silently discard failures.

rules.title: Workflow write-all permission
rules.description: Detects unbounded GitHub Actions permission declarations.

rules.title: Privileged pull-request checkout
rules.description: Detects pull_request_target combined with untrusted head checkout.

rules.title: Workflow expression injection
rules.description: Detects untrusted GitHub event interpolation directly in shell run commands.

rules.title: Unpinned workflow action
rules.description: Flags third-party actions referenced by movable tags instead of commit SHA.

rules.title: Remote script piped to shell
rules.description: Detects curl/wget content piped directly into a shell.

rules.title: Missing workflow timeout
rules.description: Detects workflow jobs without an explicit timeout bound.

rules.title: Persisted checkout credentials
rules.description: Detects checkout steps that persist credentials unnecessarily.

rules.title: Secrets in fork-capable workflow
rules.description: Flags secret references in pull_request workflows for review.

rules.title: Floating container base
rules.description: Detects Docker images using latest or an unpinned base tag.

rules.title: Dependency lock gap
rules.description: Detects dependency manifests without a corresponding lockfile.

rules.title: Unpinned Python requirement
rules.description: Detects requirements that are not version-pinned.

rules.title: Floating JavaScript dependency
rules.description: Detects wildcard/latest JavaScript dependency versions.

rules.title: Unverified remote download
rules.description: Detects remote downloads without nearby checksum verification.

rules.title: Excessive repository write scope
rules.description: Detects workflow contents-write or broad write permissions.

rules.title: Dangerous workflow trigger combination
rules.description: Detects privileged trigger combinations requiring isolation.

rules.title: Untrusted-input to dangerous-sink correlation
rules.description: Correlates external input and dynamic execution/deserialization in one source file.

rules.title: Network plus disabled TLS
rules.description: Correlates outbound network clients with disabled certificate verification.

rules.title: External input plus shell execution
rules.description: Correlates request/argument input with process or shell execution.

rules.title: Network-fed deserialization
rules.description: Correlates network reads with unsafe deserialization.

rules.title: Secret plus logging correlation
rules.description: Correlates secret-like variables with logging or console output.

rules.title: Weak crypto in authentication path
rules.description: Correlates weak digests with password/authentication code.

rules.title: Privileged workflow plus external event
rules.description: Correlates write permissions with untrusted event data.

rules.title: Pull-request privilege interference
rules.description: Correlates pull_request_target with event interpolation or write scope.

rules.title: Manifest-lock inconsistency
rules.description: Correlates dependency manifests with missing or mismatched locks.

rules.title: Multi-signal file concentration
rules.description: Flags files accumulating several independent security findings.

rules.title: Security-test bypass
rules.description: Detects skipped security-focused test jobs or test filters.

rules.title: Branch-governance bypass marker
rules.description: Detects explicit bypass/disable settings in repository governance files.

rules.title: Peer-policy drift
rules.description: Verifies canonical policy and scanner parity across federation peers.

rules.title: Cross-file risk concentration
rules.description: Correlates multiple high-risk source files in a single change set.

rules.title: Source/CI trust-boundary mismatch
rules.description: Correlates privileged workflow settings with risky source behavior.

global_rules.title: Single policy authority
global_rules.description: Policy version, required layer sizes and unique rule IDs must validate.

global_rules.title: Security-first blocking
global_rules.description: Critical/high findings block changed-file checks; lower severities remain visible.

global_rules.title: Deterministic evidence
global_rules.description: Reports are stable, structured and contain no matched secret values.

global_rules.title: Expiring exceptions
global_rules.description: Every exception requires a reason and an unexpired ISO date.

global_rules.title: Exact-path suppressions
global_rules.description: Exceptions must target one exact repository path and one rule ID.

global_rules.title: Unified risk calibration
global_rules.description: Severity-weighted scoring uses one shared scale across all repositories.
